outcome: Enable lenders to give eligible SMEs faster, explainable working-capital decisions using verified cash-flow and business-performance data.
overview: Many viable SMEs are refused or delayed because they have thin bureau files, limited collateral or inconsistent financial statements — while lenders spend heavily collecting documents and spreading financials for small facilities. This solution assembles consented bank-transaction, invoice, accounting, POS, tax and bureau data; calculates transparent cash-flow indicators; recommends eligibility, limit and pricing bands with reason codes; and monitors booked accounts for early deterioration. Credit policy, exceptions and final approval remain with the lender. An 8–12-week proof of value validates recommendations against historical decisions before any controlled offer pilot, targeting more qualified originations, faster decisions, lower underwriting cost and earlier warning of portfolio stress.

benefits.text: Cut eligible SME decision time from days to hours or minutes — a target 70% median reduction
benefits.limits: Basis: hypothesis. Depends on consented data-source coverage and how much of current policy can be encoded as rules

benefits.text: Increase qualified application conversion by a target 10–20% within agreed risk appetite
benefits.limits: Basis: hypothesis. Validated against historical decisions and a controlled offer pilot; portfolio performance is confirmed only across loan vintages

benefits.text: Reduce document spreading and underwriting effort by a target 30–50%
benefits.limits: Basis: hypothesis. Measured against a time-tracked baseline; assumes digital application channels carry most volume

residency: Deployable in-country on local AWS or Azure regions (e.g. UAE, KSA); a hybrid option keeps regulated account data and models on customer-controlled infrastructure

notFor.situation: No consented access to cash-flow data (bank transactions, accounting, invoices, POS or tax)
notFor.why: Cash-flow underwriting needs cash-flow data; bureau scores alone reproduce the thin-file problem the solution exists to solve

notFor.situation: Historical application outcomes are not linked to application data
notFor.why: The PoV benchmarks recommendations against real past decisions and performance labels; without linkage there is nothing to validate against

notFor.situation: The lender expects fully automated approvals with no exception path
notFor.why: The design keeps policy, exceptions and final approval with the lender’s credit officers; a no-human model conflicts with model-risk and conduct expectations

scope:
Model: Joint delivery: accredited implementation partner leads, with Redington architecture and commercial governance; the customer retains credit policy, final approval and model-risk accountability · Duration: 8–12 weeks PoV; 18–30 weeks to production, with performance validated across loan vintages
Delivery pod: Partner technical lead + project manager, vendor platform specialist, data scientist; customer business sponsor, credit owner, data owner, model-risk validator, privacy and security approvers, core lead, finance and collections · Support model: Business-hours standard with a critical production-support option; severity-based targets; partner first line with vendor escalation; optional managed model monitoring
1) Discovery, baseline and data design
2) Historical validation and benchmark
3) Policy configuration and integration
4) Model validation and fairness review
5) UAT and credit-team training
6) Controlled pilot, stabilisation and handover
